name: AI Live Agents
author: ailiveagents

sections.description:
AI Live Agents helps you provide instant customer support with an intelligent AI assistant.

Features:

  • Easy setup – just enter your Bot ID
  • Fully customizable AI assistant
  • Works with any WordPress theme
  • Mobile responsive
  • Exclude specific pages
  • Use shortcode for manual placement

Getting Started:

  1. Sign up at app.ailiveagents.com
  2. Create a new bot and get your Bot ID
  3. Install and activate this plugin
  4. Go to Settings → AI Live Agents
  5. Enter your Bot ID and save

External Services

This plugin connects to the AI Live Agents service to provide AI-powered customer support functionality on your WordPress website.

What the service is and what it is used for:
AI Live Agents (ailiveagents.com) is a third-party service that provides AI chatbot widgets. This plugin integrates their JavaScript widget into your WordPress site to enable AI-powered customer support conversations.

What data is sent and when:
This plugin loads the AI Live Agents widget script from https://agent.ailiveagents.com/ai-chat.es.js. No data is collected, stored, or transmitted by this WordPress plugin itself to the AI Live Agents servers. However, when website visitors interact with the AI chatbot widget, they will be required to submit their email address before starting a conversation with the AI agent. This email address, along with the user’s IP address, will be securely stored in AI Live Agents’ database for support and service purposes. All interactions between website visitors and the AI chatbot are handled directly between the user’s browser and the AI Live Agents service. Webmasters must already have an AI Live Agents account and have accepted their privacy policy to obtain the Bot ID required to activate this plugin.

Service Information:
– Service Provider: AI Live Agents
– Service URL: https://ailiveagents.com
– Privacy Policy: https://ailiveagents.com/privacy-policy
– Terms of Service: Available at ailiveagents.com

By using this plugin, you acknowledge that visitor interactions with the AI chatbot widget will be subject to AI Live Agents’ privacy policy and terms of service.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/ai-live-agents/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings → AI Live Agents to configure
sections.faq:
Where do I get my Bot ID?

Sign up at app.ailiveagents.com and create a bot. Your Bot ID will be displayed in the dashboard.

Can I customize the widget appearance?

Yes! Customize your bot’s appearance in your AI Live Agents dashboard at app.ailiveagents.com

Does it work with my theme?

Yes, the plugin works with any WordPress theme.
